## WireValue type

A value in wire form.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type WireValue = JsonValue
```

**References:** [JsonValue](./contracts.jsonvalue.md)

## Remarks

Structurally any JSON value. Which shapes are valid at a given position is defined by that position's wire schema. A bare JSON number is never valid on its own: numbers appear only as the payload of a [WireDouble](./contracts.wiredouble.md)<!-- -->.
